senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (उ.) (अञ्चति)
1 To adore, to worship, to treat with respect.
(ञ, उ.) (अंचति-ते)
2 To go, to approach.
3 To ask or beg.
4 To speak indistinctly.
With प्र,
to move in an eastern direction;
with प्रति,
to go westerly;
with उत्,
to go northerly;
with अव,
to move southerly;
with परा,
to turn aside or away.
r. 1st and 10th cl. (अंचति अंचयति)
To discriminate, to individualize, to possess especially. See अच.

m. (-तिः)
Air, wind.
E.
अञ्च to go, and अति Uṇādi aff.

m. (-लः)
The end or border of a cloth, veil, shawl, &c.
E.
अञ्च to go, and अलच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Worshipped, revered.
2 Admired.
3 Gone.
E.
the participial derivative of अञ्च to worship, &c.

f. (-भ्रूः)
A woman having beautiful eye brows.
E.
अञ्चित, and भ्रू the brow.

n. (-नं)
Partial extraction of thorns or arrows and the like from the body. आङ् before अञ्च to go, ल्युट् aff.
